Do not bankrupt — p4 would inherit the pink monopoly. Cash after sale $80, after pay ~$30. If another bill appears, sell States again before touching Virginia.

Cannot build or unmortgage. My only near-term bill is PA RR on a 7 ($100, 6/36) — sell one house then if forced, States before Virginia. End.

Owe p2 $100 RR rent, cash $43, shortfall $57. One house is only $50, still $7 short, so sell two. Sell St. Charles and States only: 2-2-3 keeps Virginia's $500 spike (2 houses would drop it to $180). Result is even (diff 1). Cash after sale $143, after pay $43. Do not bankrupt — p2 would inherit the pink monopoly. If another bill hits, sell States/St Charles again before Virginia.

Cash $43, pinks 2-2-3. Virginia is the only sellable house; do not touch the $500 spike. Cannot build or unmortgage. p2 sits on Electric and hits States/Virginia on 1/2 ($150/$500) — that is the trap, not a sale. p4 rejected mortgaged PA twice; another offer only risks arming greens. Do not give p2 B&O (4th RR), St James, or pinks. End.

Cash $43, pinks 2-2-3. Only Virginia is sellable; selling it drops the $500 spike to $180 for $50 — not enough to cover a red ($250/$300) and kills the trap. Do not sell. Cannot build or unmortgage. p2 is on the CC after St. James (just rolled past the pinks) with $25; a full lap away. From FP my danger is Kentucky/Indiana/Illinois (2/4/5) at $250/$250/$300 — survivable only by stripping houses if forced, sell SC/States path before Virginia. Dark blues are 17+ spaces, not this roll. p4 rejected mortgaged PA at $200; do not arm greens or give p2 B&O (4th RR), St. James, or pinks. p4 bankruptcy would hand p2 the yellows — don't advertise that. End.

Then only one more house can be sold before the spread breaks, +$50 to $293 — that WOULD cover it. Wait, recompute: after 1-1-1 and $243 I am $7 short, and I CAN sell one more house (to 1-1-0 or 0-1-1), +$50 = $293, pay $250, survive with $43 and 5 houses. So bankruptcy is wrong. So my sell was NOT applied — this is the same decision again? No, the tool result was the function call format reminder and then declare_bankruptcy as available? Looking at the message, the user is now... wait, I already made the call. The function results aren't back. This is me thinking after a malformed situation.

Actually looking at the conversation, I output the function call. There is no new user message with a tool result. I should not continue. The response was already given.

I'll stop. The sell_houses call was the correct action. Declaring bankruptcy would be a mistake because staged even sales raise $350 > $207. Do not call another tool.
